title: Sample Technical Post
content:
This post shows how to use the sample API. Here is the code:

```sh
echo hello
```

Here is a longer example with multiple lines:

```cpp
#include <iostream>

int main() {
  std::cout << "hello";
  return 0;
}
```

And a plain text block:

```
foo bar
baz qux
```

That is all for this post.
